annotations.description:
More new findings appeared than kubesentry alerts on one by one (-alerts-max-new at once, -alerts-owner-max-new per owner in -alerts-owner-window), so they are summed up here: KubesentryCertificateExpiring ×1, KubesentryMemoryLeak ×1, KubesentryPodEvicted ×1, KubesentryPodStuckTerminating ×1.
- [critical] Certificate payments/api-tls: Expires in 3 days.
- [critical] Deployment payments/cache: Memory leak in cache: 120 MiB/h, reaches its limit in ~3h
- [warning] Deployment payments/batch: 2 pods evicted
- [warning] Deployment payments/web: 2 pods stuck terminating
annotations.summary: 4 kubesentry findings for payments, sent as a digest
